summary: Researcher and engineering educator with a PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering focused on AI/ML for wireless networks. The research program combines reliable machine learning, data-efficient modeling, network optimization, self-healing, propagation modeling, digital twins, transfer learning, domain adaptation, generative modeling, reinforcement learning, and wearable sensing. Academic experience includes university teaching, laboratory instruction, student mentoring, publication-oriented research, proposal support, curriculum and accreditation activities, and development of reproducible simulation and experimental platforms. Industry R&D experience at AT&T Labs, Futurewei, Impac, and AT&T complements this academic foundation with large-scale operational data, 5G/NTN systems, domain-adaptive ML, and production-oriented validation.
